T0578.title: Token Binding
T0578.definition: A control that binds a token to a device, client, network, or cryptographic proof to limit replay.
T0578.description: Token binding ties a token to a device, client certificate, network context, or cryptographic key so copied tokens are less useful elsewhere. Designs must balance security with usability for device changes, mobile network switching, and recovery scenarios.
T0578.usageExample: Assess Token Binding related exposure and define the corresponding controls.

references.title: RFC 8471 - The Token Binding Protocol Version 1.0 - IETF
